findings.note: Both implementations validate upgrade_reasons only for eligible:false entries and treat falsy present scalars such as false, 0, or an empty string as absent. An eligible:true entry with malformed upgrade_reasons is also ignored. The fragment contract requires a present upgrade_reasons value to be an array, and AC-027 requires every supplied shape-invalid fragment to exit 2.

The contract pins spec_revision 2740928c..., while its own disclosure states the current revision is 466465e0... and that no independent gate pass has reviewed the current specification. The supplied verification therefore cannot establish compliance with the specification under review.

The contract records both required checks as passes:false. Its evidence also states that the full repository regression was not completed and that no quality-gate report contains the human acceptance required to waive the placeholder findings.

The report explicitly states that the required human apply step is pending and that the live protected check-risk-upgrade scripts and policy remain unchanged. Consequently AC-010/AC-031 and the corresponding Done When criterion are not yet satisfied.
